The speaker discusses a framework for large language models to improve accuracy and relevance through Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), highlighting issues with model behavior such as hallucination and outdated information. To address these challenges, RAG combines generation capabilities with a content store, allowing models to verify answers through external sources, thereby grounding their responses in more reliable knowledge. This approach aims to mitigate the problems faced by large language models when generating text responses to user queries.
